messages:
Ana (CSM): Heads up — Handrail (midmarket) dropped active seats ~35% this week, renewal in 42 days. Seeing spike in setup errors and fewer model runs. Need a fast save play with a downgrade-safe path. Thoughts? :thinking:
Sam P: Can we pull onboarding + recent telemetry? If it's setup errors we should offer a curated enablement session and temporary credits, not a discount right away.
Leo M: I'll run a quick query. If it's integration breakage we map what breaks on downgrade and what stays.
Caroline - Eng: If it's a runtime/config error we can push a forward-compatible patch or toggle a feature flag. Share logs or a repro?
Jamie (Ops): Looping in @Ashleigh for enablement assets and @Ben for pricing guardrails. Ops suggestion: credits > discount, capped.
Ashleigh (Enablement): I can run a focused 30-min workshop for their integrator — agenda + 2 repros + checklist. Low friction, recorded.
Ben (CS Lead): Credits ok but cap at $2k for midmarket deals. Need an exec-approved email template and a downgrade mapping doc before giving anything larger.
Ana (CSM): Thanks. Leo — paste the quick query when done so I can include numbers in outreach.
Leo M: Quick check: `select count(*) from runs where customer_id='HR-4319' and status='error' and ts > now() - interval '7 days';` -> 87 errors, ~60% of recent runs failing. Appears to be a package mismatch on their side.
Caroline - Eng: Created a small patch + compatibility flag. Can push to their env tomorrow morning if we get their deploy window. Patch removes the failing call path and falls back to the safe model.
Jamie (Ops): Ops playbook (short):
- flag account health to "escalate"
- schedule workshop within 48h
- apply temporary credits (track in billing)
- prepare downgrade-mapping doc (feature -> graceful degraded mapping)
- follow up 7/14/30 days
Ana (CSM): Draft outreach: "We noticed an increase in errors; would you like a 30-min session + temporary credits while we patch?" Keep it simple, include calendar link. Thoughts?
Sam P: Keep it low-friction, include a one-click calendar link and 'no charge during patch' language. :white_check_mark:
Ben (CS Lead): I approve credits for HR-4319 up to $2k. Ana, send me the account ID and proposed email before you hit send.
Ana (CSM): Account ID HR-4319. I'm drafting the playbook doc in CS Drive and will update ticket #57891 with links and timeline.
Ashleigh (Enablement): I'll prep the workshop doc and a follow-up checklist. ETA: 6 hours.
Caroline - Eng: I'll book the patch deploy for 02:00 UTC tomorrow — ping me once workshop is scheduled so we can coordinate rollback window.
Ana (CSM): Moving this to "in progress" on the save-playboard. Will post the final save-play template link and outreach copy when ready. :zap:
